source: Dirección General del Catastro · INSPIRE Buildings
method: Above-ground building parts; parent fallbacks when no usable part exists; topology-preserving simplification 0.18 m; preserved courtyard holes; WGS84 coordinates; non-overlapping OSM complement. Elevation uses source heights, normalized surface estimates, floor counts or a marked visual fallback.
note: Derived atlas product, not official cadastral information or a current facade survey.
